# StackPick

## Methods

### WithColors(IReadOnlyList&lt;(string, string)&gt;, IReadOnlyList&lt;LayerColor&gt;) { #m-withcolors-system-collections-generic-ireadonlylist-sy-cd04ac }

```csharp
public static IReadOnlyList<StackPick> WithColors(IReadOnlyList<(string, string)> present, IReadOnlyList<LayerColor> colors);
```

Attaches recorded colors to a selection.

**Parameters**

- `present` (`IReadOnlyList<(string, string)>`) - The present layers in paint order.
- `colors` (`IReadOnlyList<LayerColor>`) - Recorded per-layer colors; [`LayerColor.Layer`](../nfty-core/Nfty.Core.Output.LayerColor.md#p-layer) is the ingredient id.

**Returns.** The picks; a color is set only when both H and S were recorded. The unrounded [`LayerColor.ExactH`](../nfty-core/Nfty.Core.Output.LayerColor.md#p-exacth)/[`LayerColor.ExactS`](../nfty-core/Nfty.Core.Output.LayerColor.md#p-exacts) win, so the model is the cook's own to the bit. A Set cooked before they existed has only the rounded H (0.1 degree) and S (0.001): that fallback is within 1 LSB of an 8-bit channel, not byte-identical.
